visualCharacteristics.structure: image + heading + text + field + link + list
visualCharacteristics.purpose: article hub landing page: hero with background image, title card and article search, then groups of article cards with View all links

contentPattern.structure: row 1: hero image cell | text cell (eyebrow, H1, description, optional Search ... label paragraph); heading row (one cell with heading + optional View all link) starts a card group; card rows: image cell | text cell (title, description, link); other one-cell rows: closing CTA or note

usage: Credit card learning-center and travel-guide hub pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for category / hub pages listing articles in groups. The search filters the cards on the page. For a single article use article-body.
